summary: Retarget animations between skeletons straight from the Content Browser (Retarget Animation Assets, auto-generated IK Rigs/Retargeter), plus the IK Rig editor's Auto Retarget Chains and Auto Create IK (FBIK) tools and the IK Retargeter's Auto Align pose tools.

summary: Reference for every op in the IK Retargeter's Retarget Stack (Pelvis Motion, FK Chains, Root Motion, Remap Curves, Retarget Pose, Additive Pose, Pin Bones, Filter Bones, Scale Source, Stretch Chains, Pole Vector Alignment, Copy Base Pose, Run IK Rig) and Run IK Rig sub-ops (Blend to Source, Offset/Scale Goals, Floor Constraint, Speed Plant, Stride Warp, Relative IK Retarget, Body Intersect Goals) with their settings.

summary: Reference for every option in the FBX Import Options dialog for Static Meshes, Skeletal Meshes, Animations, Transform, Miscellaneous (coordinate/unit conversion) and Materials, plus the asset naming rules applied on import.
